title: 总账会计
company: 海控南海发展股份有限公司
description:
岗位职责：
1.负责编制公司层面合并中期及年度财务报表、快报及财务报告；
2.负责编制公司合并层面全面预算报表及报告，填报国资全面预算软件；
3.负责编报定期报告财务相关内容；
4.负责编制财务分析，对公司财务状况、经营成果进行对比分析，发现影响公司经营计划的重大问题及时向主管领导汇报；
5.负责对子公司日常核算及报表编制工作进行具体指导；
6.协助财务经理，完成对各分子公司财务工作的专项检查；
7.参与项目转向工作，为管理决策提供财务数据支持和专业建议；
8.完成公司及上级领导交办的其他工作。

任职要求：
1.本科及以上学历；
2.财务管理、会计学、金融学等相关专业优先；
3.3年及以上合并报表工作经验，上市公司经验者优先；
4.中级会计师及以上职称，高级会计师、注册会计师优先；
5.熟悉财务核算、成本核算、税务税收政策等业务流程，具备预算编制、财务管理等相关业务知识和能力，有多年编制财务报表和财务分析经验；
6.熟悉市面主流财务软件操作；
7.具有良好的职业道德，责任心强，具备较强的逻辑思维及风险防范能力。

You’ll drive healthy adoption, customer retention, revenue realization, and advocacy at scale. You will innovate, navigate ambiguity, and build scalable programs and processes to deliver real, measurable impact where your customers need it most.

 Customer Advisory 
 
 Lead and scale effective customer onboarding by leveraging product adoption telemetry to monitor early deployment health, proactively identify and mitigate configuration risks, and guide customers through prescriptive best practices, architectures, and operational strategies that establish a strong technical foundation and accelerate time-to-value and achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB

 Internal Collaboration & Customer Advocacy 
 
 Amplify the voice of the customer within MongoDB, leveraging customer insights to inform MongoDB’s product roadmap and coordinate across Sales, Product, Services, Support, and Training teams to drive customer health, satisfaction, and value realization 
 Connect customers with the right internal resources, while contributing learnings from customer interactions to strengthen team success and maximize customer value. Contribute to the evolution of scalable programs that enhance efficiency, customer satisfaction, and measurable outcomes

 Relevant Experience: 5 to 7+ years in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., Technical Customer Success, Solutions Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services/Implementation, Technical Account Management) for a deeply technical, ideally consumption-based, product

Experience in managing scaled or pooled portfolios utilizing scalable strategies to enhance customer retention is a plus. Familiarity with designing workflows or engagement strategies using AI or automation-driven tools

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.

title: Staff / Sr. Staff Engineer, AI Gateway
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
  About the Role  
 Netskope AI Gateway helps global enterprises securely adopt, scale, and govern Generative AI. We are seeking a  Staff / Sr. Staff Software Engineer  to architect, build, and scale the core systems powering our AI Gateway product and its supporting microservices across SaaS and on-prem/hybrid environments. 
 Based in Taiwan, you will be a technical anchor for our core development team. This is a hands-on, high-impact individual contributor role focused on building highly scalable backend systems, with real ownership: the systems assigned to you are yours to design, build, and defend — depth matters more than volume. You will operate at the intersection of deep distributed systems engineering and cutting-edge AI technology. We are looking for an engineering leader who leverages AI to accelerate their workflows, but possesses the rigorous, production-grade coding skills required to architect complex systems, ensure enterprise-grade security, and validate AI-generated code. 
  What You Will Be Doing  
 
  Core Backend Development:  Architect, build, and scale our core AI Gateway solutions, backend services, and high-throughput APIs. You will focus on writing highly concurrent, robust, and maintainable software, primarily in  Golang . 
  Command AI-Driven Engineering:  Integrate AI and agent-based tooling (e.g., Copilots, code generators) into your daily development workflow to accelerate scaffolding, boilerplate, and hypothesis generation.  Crucially, you will act as the gatekeeper:  you must possess the deep software engineering expertise to audit AI-generated code, ensure architectural soundness, and reject code that introduces technical debt or security flaws. 
  Design for Scale and Resilience:  Build distributed systems capable of handling immense data payloads, streaming LLM responses (Server-Sent Events), and complex proxy routing without introducing unacceptable latency. 
  Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner directly with global engineering, AI researchers, and product teams. Translate ambitious AI features into scalable, maintainable software architectures. Raise system design considerations before a single line of feature code is written. 
  Push Engineering Excellence:  Drive the technical culture of the Taiwan team through architectural reviews, code reviews, and mentorship. Advocate for best practices in modern, AI-augmented software development, security, and scalable system design. 
  Deep Systems Debugging:  While not primarily an incident support role, you will be the ultimate escalation point for the hardest systemic development roadblocks. Trace complex issues across asynchronous microservice

title: Operations Specialist
description:
Flow Traders is looking for an experienced Operations Specialist to join our APAC team in Hong Kong. The ideal candidate is analytically strong, proactive, and motivated to work in a fast-paced trading environment. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm where operational excellence, automation, and continuous improvement are at the core of how we work. 
 The Operations team is responsible for trade lifecycle management, reconciliations, settlement, and control processes that directly support our trading desks. We are building a team that goes beyond traditional mid/back-office execution: we expect our specialists to deeply understand process flows and business logic, design better solutions, and leverage AI and other tools to implement them. What matters most is the ability to analyse how things work, identify what should change, and manage the migration. 
 The role sits within our broader first-line controls function, which encompasses our traditional operations function and other First-Line controls, trade reporting, and data management. As we continue to integrate and develop this function, there are opportunities to broaden your scope beyond traditional operations into these adjacent areas, offering a varied and rewarding career path for the right candidate. 
 What You Will Do 
 
 Perform daily trade reconciliations, position monitoring, P&L attribution, and cash/cost reconciliation across multiple asset classes and prime brokers 
 Investigate and resolve trade breaks, settlement issues, and corporate action events in a timely manner, liaising with counterparties, custodians, and prime brokers 
 Analyse existing operational processes end-to-end, map business logic and data flows, and design improved solutions that reduce manual effort and error rates 
 Leverage AI-assisted development tools and scripting (Python, SQL) to build and maintain automated reconciliation, reporting, and control workflows 
 Manage and improve data pipelines that feed control and reporting workflows, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of operational data 
 Support the onboarding of new counterparties, prime brokers, and market connectivity, including SSI setup and operational readiness testing 
 Contribute to the APAC delivery of global technology and process improvement projects, collaborating with Technology teams to define requirements and validate outputs 
 Monitor and manage operational risk throughout the trade lifecycle, escalating issues proactively and contributing to root-cause analysis and remediation 
 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 
 3+ years of mid/back-office or operations experience, preferably within a proprietary trading firm, hedge fund, or prime brokerage 
 Strong technical literacy: you must be able to read, understand, and reason about code (Python, SQL) and data structures, whether you write it yourself or work with AI tools to generate it 
 Demonstrated ability to analyse complex process flows, understand the underlying business logic, and translate that into clear, implementable solution designs 
 Solid understanding of trade lifecycle processes across listed equities, ETFs, futures, FX, and/or OTC derivatives 
 Experience with reconciliation frameworks, clearing and settlement workflows, and familiarity with Asian securities markets and their respective rules 
 Comfort working with AI-assisted development and productivity tools to accelerate solution delivery 
 Ability to work with large datasets, perform analysis, and translate findings into actionable process improvements 
 Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a proactive, assertive, and flexible approach 
 Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a diverse range of tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment 
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Software Engineer | Post Trade Analytics
description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world-class research. We empower exceptional talent in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting-edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by fostering collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk-adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve complex problems.  Jump Trading's Post-Trade Analytics (PTA) Team is the firm's central source of truth for understanding how we trade. We measure, analyze, and optimize every dimension of our trading activity across all global markets. Our team builds the foundational analyses that traders and quantitative researchers rely on daily to make critical decisions. Operating across highly diverse datasets, our core infrastructure collects, organizes, and stores billions of data points every day, powering the analytics behind a wide array of trading strategies.  As a Data Engineer on the PTA team, you will own the critical datasets and pipelines upon which our trading decisions are built, all while developing in-depth technical and financial business expertise. 
  What You'll Do:  
 
 Partner directly with traders and quantitative researchers to turn complex questions into data products that shape how we trade across global markets. 
 Build, operate, and scale the robust datasets and pipelines that power our post-trade analytics and research. 
 Directly influence business priorities, trading strategies, and execution quality through high-impact data engineering. 
 Guarantee trust in the numbers by building robust data validation frameworks, monitoring, alerting, data lineage, and executing rapid incident response. 
 Drive performance by optimizing data processing and workflows for speed, cost, and resilience, while diagnosing and resolving the most complex pipeline and production issues. 
 Develop and optimize the tools, documentation, and foundational infrastructure that empower the broader research and trading teams. 
 Other duties as needed 
 
  Skills You’ll Need:  
 
 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Software Engineer working extensively with large-scale data. 
 Proficiency in Python or C++ (Strong skills in at least one, with a willingness to work across both). 
 Proven expertise in building, operating, and scaling ETL/ELT pipelines, including orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management. 
 Strong command of SQL and the broader data analytics ecosystem, including familiarity with libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. 
 Sharp analytical and problem-solving abilities, paired with a strong curiosity to understand the financial business logic behind the data. 
 Comfort and proficiency working within Linux environments. 
 Reliable and predictable availability

title: 大模型推理加速算法工程师

description: 1、核心技术研发：负责大语言模型（LLM）在推理阶段的架构级优化与加速，解决长文本（Long Context）推理及高并发场景下的性能瓶颈。 2、前沿技术落地：探索并实现大模型推理领域的最新前沿加速技术，包括但不限于 KV Cache 压缩/量化、Context 压缩、Special Token 深度定制、Layer Skipping（层跳过）、推测解码（Speculative Decoding）等。 3、推理框架协同：深入底层计算架构，配合或优化主流大模型推理框架（如 vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, DeepSpeed-FastGen, LMDeploy 等），提升系统吞吐量（Throughput）并降低首字延迟（TTFT）。 4、软硬件协同设计：针对不同硬件平台（如 NVIDIA GPU、算力芯片等）进行极致的算力算子调优，优化内存带宽与显存占用。 1、教育背景：计算机、电子信息、自动化或数学等相关专业硕士及以上学历。 2、专业经验：2年以上 大模型（LLM/VLM）相关研发经验，其中至少 1 年深入聚焦于大模型推理加速或底层吞吐调优。 3、深度理解LLM架构：熟练掌握 Transformer 架构原理，对 Attention 机制、注意力矩阵计算以及内存访问瓶颈有深刻理解。 4、加速技术常识：深入研究过并实际落地过以下至少两项技术： （1）显存与上下文优化：KV Cache Eviction/Quantization、PageAttention、长文本 Context 压缩/表征提取。 （2）架构与算子加速：Layer Skipping/Early Exiting 动态路由机制、Special Token 优化策略、FlashAttention/FlashDecoding 算子调优。 5、工程能力：精通 Python 和 C++/CUDA 编程，熟悉 PyTorch 框架，具备优秀的 Code Review 习惯。 6、框架经验：熟练使用或阅读过 vLLM、TensorRT-LLM 等至少一种开源推理框架的核心源码，有二次开发经验者优先。 加分项 在开源社区（如 vLLM, Hugging Face）有高质量 PR 贡献或维护知名加速开源项目者优先。 在 OSDI, SOSP, ASPLOS, ISCA, MLSys, NeurIPS, ICML 等系统或机器学习顶级会议发表过论文者优先。 拥有高性能计算（HPC）、并行计算（数据并行、张量并行、流水线并行）实际落地经验者优先。

 Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet.  Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system.   Moloco Ads   is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet.   Moloco Commerce Media   is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by  CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture) , the AI system behind every Moloco product. 
 At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer.  Come build what's next.     ※ This is a New Business Onboarding 'Account Manager' role, NOT a technical role.  
  What You’ll Do  
  Client Success & Relationship Management  
 
 Serve as the day‑to‑day execution owner for new advertisers during implementation, managing campaign setup, monitoring, and reporting while escalating complex issues to senior team members as needed. 
 Understand advertiser marketing objectives and support the execution of programmatic strategies to drive KPIs and early‑stage performance. 
 Support client meetings, business reviews, and strategy discussions with guidance from Senior Implementation Managers and Sales / Growth leaders. 
 Build strong, trust‑based relationships with client stakeholders through clear communication, responsiveness, and attention to detail. 
 
  Implementation, Performance & Handover  
 
 Configure and QA campaigns, tracking, and reporting to ensure accurate setup and reliable measurement from the start. 
 Analyze campaign performance data to identify issues, optimization opportunities, and early signals of product‑fit; share clear, actionable recommendations with clients and internal partners. 
 Identify incremental growth opportunities within existing setups (e.g., budget increases, creative tests, new geo or placement trials) and surface them to senior team members or Sales/Growth partners. 
 Support the transition from implementation to the Growth team by preparing concise documentation and performance debriefs that set long‑term owners up for success. 
 
  Cross‑Functional Collaboration  
 
 Partner with New Business Sales to understand what was sold, customer expectations, and key success criteria for the first 90 days. 
 Collaborate with Growth, Product, and Data Science to address configuration, measurement, and performance questions, and share client feedback that can improve our tools and processes. 
 
  AI-Powered Productivity & Tooling  
 
 Use AI large language models (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, NotebookLM) in day-to-day work — pitch prep, app/competitor research, account categorization, performance summaries, meeting notes, and client-facing materials — to improve quality and turnaround time. 
 Adopt and contribute to the team's internal AI workflows and tools, and help identify new opportunities to automate repetitive, low-value tasks. 
 Apply sound judgment when using AI: verify outputs against source data, protect client and company confidentiality, and follow Moloco's responsible-AI and data-handling guidelines.

title: Junior Quantitative Researcher - Deep Learning (Time Series)
description:
About Akuna:  
 Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions and automation. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies and mathematical models. 
 Our Founding Partners, including Akuna's CEO Andrew Killion, first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Shanghai, Sydney, Singapore and London. 
 At Akuna, we believe that the people are the centre of everything we do. Akuna Software Technologies was our first international office and opened in the Fall of 2014. Our Shanghai office works with the latest hardware and software technologies to develop high performance low latency solutions that are robust and scalable, ensuring our strategies are as fast as possible for Akuna’s global trading operations. We run happy hours, have a fully stacked snack room with free drinks and fresh fruits, host team events, social club events, and offer great training with our Akuna University. We are looking for the best talent to join us on the journey. If you enjoy being part of smart, driven teams with real challenges to solve- this could be the place for you! 
  What you’ll do as a Junior Quantitative Researcher at Akuna:  
 We're looking for a Junior Quantitative Researcher who will work specifically on deep learning projects involving large-scale time series data. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on DL experience over general ML/data science backgrounds. In this role you will: 
 
 Develop trading strategies using statistical and deep learning technologies 
 Design and implement optimization algorithms for portfolio construction 
 Develop quantitative models describing market behavior 
 Advance existing initiatives and explore opportunities for new research topics 
 
  Qualities that make great candidates:  
 
 Bachelors, Masters or PhD in a technical field – Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics (or a related subject),  graduate(d) during Jul 2023 - Jul 2027  
  Deep learning experience is required:  hands-on work with neural network architectures (e.g., RNNs, LSTMs, Transformers, TCNs, or similar) applied to sequential or time series data — through research, working projects, competitions, or internships 
 Programming skills: Strong Python programming experience, including familiarity with DL frameworks (PyTorch and/or TensorFlow); C++ knowledge is a plus 
 Experience handling large-scale datasets efficiently — data pipelines, batching, and training at scale (GPU experience is a plus) 
 Solid foundation in math and statistics, with the ability to translate real-world, noisy, high-dimensional problems into mathematical/DL models 
 Prior exposure to time series-specific challenges (non-stationarity, autocorrelation, forecasting, sequence modeling) is a strong plus 
 Financial experience is not a requirement 
 Willing to communicate in English at the technical interviews     
 
  Please note:   If you apply to multiple roles, you may be asked to complete multiple coding challenges and interviews.

This team works closely with partner teams throughout the hardware and software product lifecycle, from hardware manufacturing to Android app teams. We also work with external vendors on part selection and initial hardware bring-up.

 Bring up new devices and lead debugging and performance tuning exercises that span multiple hardware/firmware/software teams.

 Analyze bug reports and manage the defect resolution process (disposition issues, resolve issues, and report issue status). 
 Interact with global teams with excellent communication skills to provide support information 
 Routinely perform code reviews to ensure high quality designs and implementation 
 Assist in ensuring quality and timeliness of product/feature development. Work closely with QA staff to ensure appropriate test cases are created, maintained, and executed. 
 Proactively solve problems and work independently and within a team environment, with limited guidance. 
 
  Who you are  
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
  Minimum requirements  
 
 2+ years software engineering experience in device driver development, embedded systems, or operating systems 
 2+ years working with mobile or other connected devices 
 Experience using automated testing, build systems, and inter-component communication protocols such as UART, GPIO, SPI, I2C, etc. 
 Proficiency in C/C++ or Kotlin/Java 
 Experience with Android OS, and familiarity with associated software development tools 
 Degree in CS, CE, EE, or equivalent practical experience 
 Experience adding, monitoring and parsing telemetry data to proactively resolve issues 
 Fluency in both written and spoken English and Mandarin Chinese to be able to communicate with our vendors and users/customers 
 
  Preferred qualifications  
 
 Experience with ARM platform 
 Experience working with microcontrollers 
 Knowledge of EMV. 
 Knowledge of cryptography, symmetric, asymmetric, key management and exchange is an asset. 
 Experience with POS Hardware and peripherals. 
 Knowledge and expertise of PCI technology, transaction processing, and related retail standards.

Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by incentivizing collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems.  Core Development is a global team of technologists who architect, build and maintain our world-class trading platform. From optimizing our core trading engine to building custom hardware, we leverage software and hardware engineering, data science and research, to deliver the infrastructure and tools that drive our trading and business needs. 
 ------------------------------- *Candidates should be interested in working in one of our APAC offices for their full-time job after graduation. ------------------------------- 
  About the Role:  
 Our APAC C++ team sits at the intersection of trading and technology — we build and maintain the live trading system, risk infrastructure, back testing infrastructure and platforms for post-trade analysis. You'll work on problems that matter, ship code that runs in production, and collaborate directly with various businesses, operations, and research teams across the firm. 
  Responsibilities:  
 C++ is our primary language and it touches everything we do. The scope is wide: 
 
  Live trading system  — Design, build, and maintain the systems that connect our strategies to the exchange, including market data handling, order entry, and the full order lifecycle in between. Ensure these systems are optimized for high performance while remaining robust. 
  Business-specific infrastructure  — Build the trading platforms that support the firm's expansion into new businesses and markets. Deliver solutions that enable strategic initiatives and make trading more efficient and intelligent 
  Risk infrastructure  — Design the modules that monitor performance in real-time and apply pre-trade and post-trade controls across trading systems components to reduce the chance of outsized losses 
  Back testing infrastructure  — Build and maintain the back testing infrastructure used by researchers to evaluate systematic strategies against large-scale historical market data 
  Post-trade analysis  — Produce the datasets that traders and quantitative researchers rely on daily to make critical decisions. We build high-throughput, reliable C++ compute engines to collect, organize, and enrich billions of data points about our orders and market data every day, powering the analytics behind a wide array of trading strategies. 
  Production ownership  — Debug real incidents, trace data through the full pipeline, and fix root causes. You build it, you run it, you own it 
 
  Profile:  
 
 You write clean, production-quality code and take pride in the craft — not just making it work, but making it right 
 You are self-driven and proactive, with a natural instinct to take ownership and push through ambiguity 
 You collaborate well across teams — trading, operations, finance, and engineering all depend on what we build 
 You thrive in a fast-paced trading environment where priorities shift, projects need to move quickly, and you constantly need to pick up new skills and knowledge 
 You are genuinely curious about how things work under the hood — systems, markets, data flows — and you go deeper than the surface 
 You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc) to move faster — and you have the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to question it

title: Staff Engineer, CASB API
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    About the role  
  Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
 The API Protection Team (formerly Kloudless, Inc.) is responsible for accelerating support for SaaS apps across Netskope’s CASB offering. We focus on key abstractions across the integration pipeline: Auth{n,z}, REST APIs, webhooks, and more. We use popular programming languages and cloud technologies in our stack: Go, Python, TypeScript, Angular, React, Kubernetes, Docker, Redis, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, and more! 
  What's in it for you  
 
 As a member of the API Protection Team you will work cross-functionally to build state-of-the-art cloud platforms to support our growing portfolio of API Protection solutions. 
 
  What you will be doing  
 
 Architecting and implementing critical software infrastructure for distributed large-scale multi-cloud environments 
 Reviewing architectures and designs across the organization to help guide other engineers to build scalable cloud services 
 Providing technical leadership and strategic direction for large-scale distributed cloud-native solutions 
 Being a catalyst for improving engineering processes and ownership 
 Researching, incubating, and driving new technologies to ensure we are leveraging the latest innovations 
 Please note, this team is hiring across Software Engineer, Sr. Software Engineer and Staff Software Engineer levels and all candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience. 
 
  Required skills and experience  
 
 8+ years of experience including 2+ years of experience building cloud environments  
 Excellent Unix/Linux experience and programming experience with Go, C/C++, Java and scripting: Python, Ruby, Shell 
 Understanding of IPC mechanisms and previous experience working with: TCP/IP, Kafka, ZMQ, gRPC, ZooKeeper. 
 Strong background in cloud environments: containers, Docker, Kubernetes, etcd, ZooKeeper, service meshes, Vault, Istio and Envoy, API gateways, load balancers. 
 Experience with databases, general understanding of ACID, consistency, SQL/NoSQL, key-value stores, time series and columnar databases. 
 Experience in CI/CD, using tools like Drone, Github, Makefiles, etc. 
 Experience with in-memory databases like Redis 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
 Bonus points for experience with Node.js & Express to build REST APIs services 
 
  Education  
 
 BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred

title: Senior Technical Sourcer, APAC (Contractor)
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.    Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.   The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.    Senior Technical Sourcer, APAC (Contractor)  
 About the job 
 The Trade Desk is a global technology company helping advertisers reach audiences across the open internet - from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more. 
 Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. 
 The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges-from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. 
 As a Senior Technical Sourcer supporting APAC, you will build the talent pipelines that support our Engineering and Applied Science teams. Partnering closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and technical leaders, you will translate hiring priorities into targeted sourcing strategies, engage exceptional technical talent, and bring market insights into hiring decisions. 
 You will own sourcing strategy and upper-funnel execution across multiple APAC markets, adapting your approach to different talent ecosystems, candidate motivations, and hiring needs. This role suits someone who combines hands-on sourcing expertise with sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to turn data into action. 
 What You’ll Do 
 
 Develop and own sourcing strategies across APAC, tailoring your approach by role, level, location, and skill set for Engineering and Applied Science hiring. 
 Build and manage healthy talent pipelines, from market mapping and prospect identification through engagement, initial qualification, and handoff to recruiting partners. Balance immediate hiring needs with long-term relationships for critical talent areas. 
 Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to define target profiles, calibrate candidate quality, agree priorities, and establish clear handoffs and feedback loops. 
 Engage hard-to-reach technical talent through thoughtful, personalized outreach. Translate The Trade Desk’s engineering challenges, business impact, and culture into compelling conversations grounded in candidates’ interests and motivations. 
 Use funnel data to improve results, tracking outreach response, candidate engagement, qualification, and downstream conversion. Diagnose where pipelines lose momentum and recommend practical changes to targeting, messaging, or assessment alignment. 
 Bring actionable APAC market intelligence to hiring discussions, including talent availability, competitor activity, candidate compensation expectations, and location-specific dynamics. Use evidence to inform realistic expectations and hiring trade-offs. 
 Explore and apply AI-assisted research, automation, and emerging sourcing tools to improve research depth, relevance, and efficiency, while maintaining accuracy, candidate privacy, and personalized engagement. 
 Diversify sourcing

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer - Linux, PC, IoT
description:
Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, “the world’s best free software platform”. The Commercial Engineering Quality Assurance (QA) team works with all the engineering teams in Canonical, OEM and ODM customers, to bring Ubuntu directly to millions of users by delivering certified Ubuntu laptop, desktop, IoT and other computing devices. 
 As a Software QA engineer, you will join the team responsible for our strategy for quality coordination and testing. You will be a quality expert with extensive experience establishing quality processes from the ground up. You will understand the tools and techniques used to introduce new products, and will work with teams across the company to drive quality improvements through the entire development cycle. 
 Location: This is an office-based role in Beijing. 
  As a Software Quality Assurance Engineer you will:  
 
 Plan, create and manage the overall Quality Planning strategy and document 
 Improve our automated test capability with design and code contributions 
 Perform automated and manual testing of Ubuntu Desktop, Server and Core on varies latest hardware. 
 Suggest solutions to identified product problems 
 Collaborate with the Project team to ensure consistent project execution 
 Identify quality assurance process bottleneck and suggest improvements 
 Oversee continuous improvement projects  
 Collect quality data 
 Establish proactive measures to improve the quality and reliability of the Ubuntu platform 
 Prepare time estimates and schedule for testing activities 
 Identify, isolate, and document bugs clearly and concisely in the bugs database 
 Work with development teams across multiple projects to build efficient, effective automated testing 
 Communicate effectively with colleagues in a variety of time zones around the world 
 Triage test reports and customer bugs 
 
  The successful Software Quality Assurance Engineer will have :  
 
 Experience with the Linux desktop, and related technologies. Ubuntu experience would be a plus 
 Solid grasp of commercial Software QA practices and ideas on how to integrate them into Linux Community standards 
 Experience with common scripting languages, including Shell script, Python or JavaScript 
 Comfortable with online communication and collaboration such as mailing lists, Mattermost, wiki 
 Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills 
 Strong written and spoken communication skills in English 
 Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team 
 Ability to pick up new technologies and achieve high effectiveness quickly 
 
  What Canonical Offers:  
 
 Learning and development 
 Annual compensation review 
 Recognition rewards 
 Annual leave 
 Priority Pass for travel 
 Annual health check 
 
  About Canonical  
 Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing. 
 Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

company: 广东小鹏汽车科技集团有限公司
description: 职位描述 让人形机器人稳稳地走过地面、拉开一扇门、拿起并搬运物体，每一个动作背后都有复杂的动力学与接触问题。我们正在建设面向真实任务的机器人仿真平台，让同一套机器人软件在虚拟世界与真机上运行，让仿真中的成功与失败能够为真机研发提供依据。 你将与运控、操作算法和硬件团队一起，深入执行器、机构和接触行为，用真机数据检验模型、用物理模型解释差异。工作的成果会直接用于人形机器人的算法验证和整机评测，从一次关节响应到一个完整操作任务，都能看到自己的建模与工程工作如何影响机器人表现。 工作方向 根据你的专长，重点负责以下一至两个方向： 1. 机器人建模与控制仿真：开展机器人运动学与动力学建模，参与控制系统的仿真集成与验证，提升仿真与真实机器人行为的一致性，支撑运动控制与智能操作算法的研发迭代。 2. Sim-to-Real 与真机一致性：设计实验，辨识执行器、传动、摩擦和时延等关键因素，建立并校准物理模型，解决仿真与真机在运动、负载和接触行为上的差异。 3. 接触物理与物体交互：探索足地接触、灵巧操作和复杂物体交互，支持门、抽屉等关节物体以及布料、线缆等柔性对象，让机器人能够在仿真中完成更丰富的真实任务。 4. 复杂机构与高效仿真：面向推杆、闭链等机构开展动力学与等效建模，在物理精度、求解稳定性和运行效率之间找到适合任务的方案，并通过实验验证。 职位要求 1. 本科及以上学历，机器人、自动化、机械、计算机、应用数学、物理等相关专业。 2. 熟练使用 C++ 或 Python，能够完成算法实现、仿真调试和实验数据分析，具备良好的工程习惯。 3. 在机器人运动学与动力学、控制仿真、系统辨识、物理引擎或接触仿真中，至少有一个方向的扎实基础和项目经验。 4. 使用过 Isaac Sim、MuJoCo、PhysX 等仿真工具或其他动力学求解平台，理解所用模型的基本假设，能够分析仿真结果与实验现象之间的差异。 5. 对机器人如何运动、如何与物理世界交互有持续兴趣，愿意通过实验和数据解决问题，能够与不同专业的同事协作。 加分项 - 有人形机器人、足式机器人或机械臂的真机调试与验证经验。 - 熟悉机器人运动控制、全身控制或学习型控制方法，或有视觉语言动作模型（VLA）的应用、部署与仿真评测经验。 - 在执行器辨识、复杂传动、闭链机构、接触求解或柔性体仿真方面有深入研究或工程成果。 - 有物理引擎、数值计算或求解器开发经验，或有相关开源贡献、论文及可展示的项目。 欢迎机器人、物理仿真、机械动力学及游戏物理背景的候选人。我们看重你在某个方向解决复杂问题的能力，具体职责会结合你的专长确定。

title: 具身智能仿真平台 Agent 工程师
company: 广东小鹏汽车科技集团有限公司
description: 职位描述 面向环境交互 Agent、评测 Agent、仿真框架与场景生成等方向招聘，根据个人专长承担其中一至两个方向。 我们正在为人形机器人构建一个能够感知、行动和交互的虚拟世界。在这里，机器人需要理解人的需求，穿行于动态环境，操作物体，并与人类角色和其他机器人协作；世界也会随着它的行为发生变化。 你将参与连接机器人软件、多智能体、三维场景与模型评测的平台建设，与机器人算法、世界模型和基础设施团队协作，把新的模型与生成能力变成可运行的交互环境，让机器人在走进真实世界之前经历更丰富的任务与考验。 工作方向 根据你的专长，重点负责以下一至两个方向： 1. 仿真引擎与平台架构：建设连接机器人与虚拟世界的运行框架，让机器人通过与真机一致的感知和控制接口完成任务；设计世界状态、时钟同步、运行隔离与回放机制，支持从本地调试到云端评测的开发流程。 2. 多智能体与自主交互：为仿真环境中的虚拟人物和其他机器人构建感知、推理、规划、对话与协作能力，使其能够围绕任务目标自主行动、主动发起交互，并对被测机器人的行为作出动态响应；探索大模型驱动的环境演化与任务生成，构建丰富、可控、可复现的交互场景。 3. Agentic Real-to-Sim 与资产生成：构建从真实场景与任务需求到可交互仿真环境的自动化流程，让 Agent 理解图像、视频、扫描数据和自然语言，自主规划并调用三维重建、资产检索、生成与编辑工具，完成场景还原、物体分解、语义与可交互属性配置，以及任务场景扩展；结合几何、碰撞和物理可用性检查迭代修复，通过实测数据与人工复核校验关键属性，建设相机与视觉传感器仿真、渲染及成像一致性能力，为机器人提供接近真实环境的视觉输入。 4. 评测 Agent 与自动化分析：与算法团队设计任务与指标，构建能够根据测试目标生成场景与用例、调用仿真工具执行任务的评测 Agent；结合运行日志、视频和机器人状态分析失败原因、比较模型版本，自动生成附带过程证据的评估报告，并探索由失败案例驱动的测试扩展与持续回归。指标计算由评测工具完成，Agent 负责调用与分析，主观评价及复杂归因支持人工复核。 5. 自动化与规模化运行：将复杂任务沉淀为可重复执行的实验，建设运行监控、异常诊断和回归能力，协同基础设施团队提升评测吞吐与稳定性，让新模型和新场景能够持续进入验证流程。 职位要求 1. 本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、机器人、自动化等相关专业。 2. 熟练掌握 C++ 或 Python，具备良好的软件设计和调试能力，能够独立完成模块开发与交付。 3. 在以下任一方向有实际项目经验：仿真或游戏引擎、机器人软件、多智能体或 Agent 系统、三维图形与场景工具、模型评测或自动化测试开发。 4. 能将复杂需求拆解为清晰的接口和模块，关注系统的可扩展性与稳定性，能够通过实验、日志和数据定位问题。 5. 对具身智能和交互式虚拟世界有兴趣，愿意与算法及其他工程团队协作，将探索性方案做成可持续使用的平台能力。 加分项 - 熟悉 Isaac Sim、Unity、Unreal Engine 等引擎，或有 ROS/ROS 2、设备通信、音视频及实时系统经验。 - 有大模型 Agent、工具调用、记忆与规划、多智能体协作或游戏 AI 开发经验。 - 有 USD 资产流水线、相机与成像仿真、具备三维重建、3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）、三维生成（3DGen）、程序化场景生成或物理渲染中至少一个方向的经验者优先；有将重建与生成资产接入物理仿真环境的经验者优先。 - 有评测 Agent、自动化测试生成、多模态日志与视频分析、评估报告生成经验，或有机器人及模型评测、实验管理与回归工具开发经验。 - 有视觉语言动作模型（VLA）的应用、部署或评测经验，熟悉机器人操作任务的测试设计、效果评估与失败分析。 欢迎机器人软件、游戏引擎、图形学、3D重建/生成、Agent 开发和测试开发背景的候选人。你可以从擅长的方向切入，参与构建机器人与虚拟世界交互的核心能力。

title: Trading Intern
description:
Flow Traders is looking for entrepreneurial, competitive, and analytical students to join our Trading department as an Intern. What better way to find out if a career in Trading is something for you, than by experiencing it yourself as a Trading Intern! 
 You will get a 360-degree view of our role in the financial markets, how our Traders seize opportunities, and how they work together as a team to optimize and improve their trading desk. This Trading internship is about immersing yourself in the financial markets and experiencing trading up close. You do not need to have a financial background; we will teach you all you need to know. 
 Experience with a scientific programming language or excel is a definite advantage. Working closely with Traders and Quantitative Researchers, you will add value by working on real trading projects. You will solve problems, create new tools and/or design new strategies. You will test your project in a trading simulation. 
 What You Will Do 
 
 Learn directly from industry leaders on the APAC Trading floor 
 Participate in educational courses and trading simulations 
 Design trading strategies through project-based work using quantitative modelling and trading applications 
 Work through real life trading problems with our Traders and Quantitative Researchers 
 Gain insight into Flow Traders’ core business 
 Participate in intern activities and become a part of our “One Team” culture 
 
  Internship Duration    
 
 June 2027 - July 2027/ December 2027 - January 2028 
 This is a full-time paid internship and will last for 6 weeks 
 Flight and accommodation will be provided to all successful overseas applicants. 
 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 
 Graduating between August 2027 and December 2028 with a Degree in Finance, Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or related disciplines 
 Experience with a scientific programming language (e.g. Python / MATLAB / R or similar) 
 Competitive, innovative & creative personality with excellent mental arithmetic skills 
 Capability to reason logically and deliver under pressure 
 Ability to spot opportunities and the assertiveness to seize them   
 
  If you do not receive a confirmation email after you applied on our website, please contact  careers.hongkong@hk.flowtraders.com .  
  Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed the sole property of Flow Traders, and no placement fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Engineering
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.     Your Location:  
  This position is CHINA BASED . The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Your recruiter will inform you what cities you are able to work from depending on your personal legal working identity and Airbnb internal policies. 
   
  The Community You Will Join:  
 Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.  
 The Community Support Products (CSP) Machine Learning team is the core team responsible for driving CSxAI (Customer Support x Artificial Intelligence) initiatives by adopting the Generative AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional service experience. The team develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and tools including LLM fine-tuning and optimization, RAG/Search,  LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb.  
 The richness of Airbnb's data, the complexity of its marketplace and the variety innate in our product mean that we need to operate at the state of the art of AI practice. We are committed to investing in long term innovation to solve the complex problems we face, and to do that we need the very best experts in ML and AI to join us. 
   
  The Difference You Will Make:  
 We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.  
 You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.  
 Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities. 
   
  A Typical Day:   
 
 
 Envision, champion, and support the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems 
 
 
 Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products 
 
 
 Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team across regions( China and the US).  
 
 
   
  Your Expertise:  
 
 PhD/Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience 
 2-4 years of ML engineering experience, with ownership responsibility over large-scale software systems.  
 Background in the design and development of AI and ML systems and services, and a deep passion for building efficient and scalable ML-powered products 
 Experience with LLM driven chatbot and Agentic AI products would be a big plus 
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering, product & design organizations 
  Fluency in both English and Mandarin is essential.  
 
   
  Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:  
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

title: Sr Accountant
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.    Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.   The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.    Who we are  
 The Trade Desk is changing the way global brands and their agencies advertise to audiences around the world. How? With a media-buying platform that helps brands deliver a more insightful and relevant ad experience for consumers — and sets a new standard for global reach, accuracy, and transparency. We are proud of the culture we have built. We value the unique experiences and perspectives that each person brings to The Trade Desk, and we are committed to fostering inclusive spaces where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work every day. 
 So if you’re talented, driven, creative, and hungry to join a dynamic, globally-connected team, then we want to talk! 
 The Trade Desk is seeking a China country specialist at the Senior Accountant level based in our Shanghai office. Reporting to the Assistant Controller, a successful candidate will have a good understanding of financial accounting and China compliance and tax requirements, be hands-on in resolving accounting operation issues and able to provide solutions drawing on past experiences. The Senior Accountant will work as an individual contributor and collaborate with other stakeholders (e.g., stakeholders within the organization, external third-party consultants, external auditors, etc.)

 Manage third party external service providers that provide statutory compliance, tax consultancy, treasury, and statutory audit. 
 Act as the first point of contact for local tax authorities in China and respond to their requests in timely manner. 
 Collaborate with accounting operations functions, including credit and collections, accounts payable, payroll and stock admin teams, to provide country-level support.

title: 质量运营
company: 广东小鹏汽车科技集团有限公司
description: 一、商品企划运营与质量检核 1、建立并推行商品企划全流程的质量评价与检核机制，确保关键决策节点的输出质量，并能有效支撑车型的商业成功。 2、设计并实施多层级（如季度/年度评审、专项课题检查）的商品企划运营检核机制。通过项目关键阀点交付物的质量评审，系统性识别决策风险、流程断点与跨部门协作问题，并输出体系化的优化建议。 二、体系搭建及迭代 1、构建覆盖 “流程搭建 - 目标监控 - 执行检核 - 问题复盘 - 持续迭代” 的全链路质量管控体系； 2、主导共性问题的根因分析，提出改进建议，优化流程断点，协调跨部门推动闭环并验证改善效果； 三、中心跨部门能力建设 1、支持中心相关业务系统建设，探索并推动AI等智能技术在市场趋势分析、用户需求洞察、数据分析、文案生成等场景的提效使用。 2、根据公司及中心战略发展要求，承接与商品企划质量运营相关的流程优化、方法论沉淀及内部培训等能力建设任务。 1. 全日制本科及以上学历，车辆工程、工业设计、市场营销、管理学或统计学等相关专业优先，需深刻理解整车开发流程，并熟悉产品定义、用户体验管理或数据驱动决策的相关方法论。 2. 5年以上汽车行业经验，具备质量运营、业务流程管理、产品经理或项目管理等领域经验。需完整参与过2个及以上整车项目的质量运营、项目管理、产品定义或用户体验定义工作。 3. 具备较强的逻辑思维能力、数据分析能力和风险识别敏感度。拥有出色的跨部门沟通与协调能力，能够从用户视角和商业视角出发，敏锐洞察潜在风险。工作积极主动，具备优秀的团队协作精神和推动复杂问题解决的能力

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent through collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems. 
 We are seeking a self-driven and motivated individual to join Jump’s Recruiting Team! If you have a natural curiosity to learn about talent acquisition and on-boarding new hires in the fin-tech space, we encourage you to explore this opportunity with Jump. Attracting and retaining premier talent is our top priority and the Talent Acquisition Coordinator will collaborate extensively with the HR and Recruiting teams to provide a world class recruiting experience with Jump. 
 What You'll Do: 
  
 
 Interface with vendors, candidates, and colleagues to schedule and manage all candidate interviews. 
 Track all interview details in the applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. 
 Serve as the main point of contact for all candidates on their interview day. 
 Analyze pre-employment paperwork, reviewing for accuracy and completeness. 
 Coordinate travel arrangements for candidates with internal travel team. 
 Update and maintain all candidate profiles in Greenhouse and confirm all relevant data is captured and tracked. 
 Collaborate extensively with global recruiting team to create successful strategies for marketing Jump and building our brand. 
 Other duties as assigned or needed. 
 
  
 Skills You'll Need: 
  
 
 Strong organizational skills. 
 Must be proficient in MS Outlook, Word & Excel. 
 At least 3+ years previous administrative experience strongly preferred. 
 Previous experience using an ATS, CRM, or candidate management tool preferred but not required. 
 Excellent data entry skills and exceptional attention to detail. 
 A hardworking and upbeat personality. 
 Proactive and resourceful problem-solving skills. 
 Experience working in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment. 
 Excellent communicator with a customer service mindset. 
 Reliable and predictable availability.

title: Staff SDET, AI Gateway
description:

We are looking for a  Staff Software Development Engineer in Test  (SDET) to own quality for significant areas of the AI Gateway product, its supporting services, and its APIs, across SaaS and on-prem/hybrid customer environments. 
 This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with real ownership. The areas assigned to you are yours: you set the testing direction and build what is needed to execute it, bringing hard calls to the QE lead as a peer rather than waiting for a specification or a checklist before you act. 
 Depth matters more than volume in this role. title: Risk Manager
description:
Flow Traders is looking for an experienced Risk Manager to join our Risk team in Hong Kong. The ideal candidate is communicative, decisive, and thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. 
 The Risk Manager will report into the regional Head of Risk and work alongside a small team responsible for Market & Credit Risk (MCR) and Treasury & Capital Management (TCM) across our APAC trading business. This is a hands-on role that combines quantitative risk analysis in close collaboration with Trading and Technology. 
 What You Will Do 
 
 Evaluate and monitor APAC trading positions against market and credit risk limits, across multiple asset classes including Digital Assets 
 Provide management with regular updates on P&L and risk exposure 
 Analyse trading strategies and perform quantitative and qualitative risk analysis 
 Support the Head of Risk in developing and enhancing the risk management framework, policies, and procedures for the region, working in coordination with global Risk teams 
 Develop, implement, and enhance risk models, quantitative analytics, reports, and processes, using automation and AI tools 
 Ensure other risk categories, including credit, operational, and regulatory risk, are managed within the business's risk appetite 
 Support daily Treasury, securities borrowing and lending (SBL), and capital management activities 
 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 
 3-5 years of relevant risk management experience within a trading environment 
 Degree in Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Computing, or a related quantitative field 
 Strong financial markets, products, and valuation knowledge across multiple asset classes. Knowledge of Digital Assets is preferred. 
 Comfortable making decisive, well-reasoned calls on OTC risk requests under time pressure 
 Proficient in SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in applying AI tools to improve the efficiency of risk processes 
 Adaptable to a multi-prime broker environment and APAC-specific market structures 
 Strong communicator and team player, able to work directly with Traders, Technology, and external stakeholders 
 Meticulous and detail-oriented, with strong numerical and logical reasoning abilities 
 
  Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

title: Senior Software Engineer, C++
description:
Flow Traders is looking for Senior C++ Software Engineers to join our growing team in Hong Kong. Software Engineers at Flow Traders provide us with our competitive edge, equipping Researchers and Traders with the information and capabilities that they need to make sound business decisions. C++ plays a critical role in our event-driven trading systems, which are designed to reliably handle vast amounts of data at ultra-low latencies. 
 As a C++ Engineer, you will build systems used to analyze and trade tens of thousands of products across hundreds of global trading venues every day. Working closely with Technologists, Quantitative Researchers, and Traders, you’ll guide the development of our in-house trading technology and optimize it to achieve market-leading performance and reliability.  We hire careful and conscientious engineers who appreciate the challenge of memory, performance, battery and connectivity constrained code that has to work every time in an unreliable and unforgiving world, on x86, ARM or RISC-V silicon. 
 Canonical Ubuntu is the leading Linux for software engineers, desktops, cloud and IoT. We bring open source to the world as a high-performance, safe and secure platform for enterprise computing, software engineering, and connected devices. 
 These smart, connected devices have the potential to transform every industry. Classic Ubuntu – desktop or server – is widely used in embedded systems because of its developer focus and enterprise grade security maintenance. We partner with the world's most prominent silicon companies to optimise Ubuntu on their latest and greatest chips, as well as with major OEMs and ODMs (PC, servers and connected device manufacturers) to ensure that Ubuntu works perfectly on their hardware. 
 But while classic, ‘deb’ based Ubuntu is ideal for developers, it has too much variability for appliance or connected device environments, where you want to know *exactly* what the state of millions or billions of devices might be. So Canonical builds Ubuntu Core, a fully containerised version of Ubuntu that is mathematically precise and rigorously secure. We are working on additional solutions for even smaller devices. 
 We have several teams that focus on open source for embedded environments. We hire outstanding Linux software engineers with a passion for open source, innovation, cutting-edge hardware and software technologies in general. You will be expected to make significant contributions through high-quality design and code, and to develop your technical leadership. 
 These roles include:

 At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open source community. title: Open Source Networking Software Engineer - ToR Switch / SmartNIC / DPU
location: Home Based - Americas; Home Based - APAC; Office Based - Beijing, China; Office Based - Taipei, Taiwan
description:
Software has moved to play a central role in network technology. From outstanding routing implementations like Bird and FRR to overlay networking technology such as OVN/OVS and Cilium, from kernel with SwitchDev to userspace with DPDK, from P4 to OpenFlow, the relationship between network innovation and software continues to deepen. We are building teams to bring the very best open source networking software to market in a well integrated and opinionated stack that brings the latest hyperscaler innovation to end users and enterprise customers. 
 We work with networking silicon providers to optimize Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data center networking, from bare metal through virtualization, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically. 
 You will have a good chance of success if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking, with a special interest in the interface of hardware ASICs for acceleration and software for innovation and control. We value experience in open switch initiatives such as SoNIC and DENT, and upstream experience with components such as routing, kernel networking, eBPF, DNS, firewalls and load balancers. Our selection process is rigorous and requires work from the candidate as six to eight interviews over a period of months. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation, security and performance in your work. 
 At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community and industry leading partners in developing future-proof networking solutions. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core, Private Clouds, MAAS and Kubernetes across a broad range of devices and use cases. 
  Location : we have network software engineering roles in APAC (Top-of-Rack switches) and Americas (SmartNIC/DPU) time zones. 
 What your day will look like 
 
 Work with the most advanced operating systems and network application technologies available

description:
Are you fascinated by the chance to make a real impact on millions of Ubuntu users? We are looking for a passionate Linux kernel engineer to join our team and help us bring Ubuntu to the next generation of hardware. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining high-quality kernel support for a wide range of hardware devices. You will also work with upstream developers and driver vendors to integrate the latest hardware support into Ubuntu.

You will tackle complex issues spanning a wide range of consumer components, from Wi-Fi and Thunderbolt docks to BIOS and UEFI. title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Test Engineer
location: Home Based - APAC; Office Based - Beijing, China; Office Based - Taipei, Taiwan
description:
Ubuntu is the most widely used Linux distribution in the world, delivering kernels across a vast matrix of versions, architectures, and configurations – with up to 15 years of security and maintenance commitments for Long Term Support (LTS) releases. Ensuring the quality and reliability of these kernels demands a dedicated, systematic approach to testing at scale. 
 The Canonical Kernel Team is looking for a Test Engineer to take ownership of our kernel testing strategy and infrastructure. You will design and maintain test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security. You will build and evolve automated test frameworks – including stress testing, fuzzing, code coverage analysis, and regression detection – that not only must remain effective across many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance, but must be able to scale with the high demand for Ubuntu kernels (currently more than 160 under active support). 
 The successful candidate will bring strong Python skills, familiarity with Linux kernel internals, and experience building test infrastructure that scales. You will work closely with kernel engineers to catch regressions early, validate fixes, and ensure every kernel we ship meets the highest standards of reliability. 
  Location:  This role will be based remotely in the APAC region, except for Taipei, Taiwan, and Beijing, China, which are office-based locations. 
 What your day will look like 
 
 Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security for Ubuntu Linux kernels 
 Build and improve automated test infrastructure for continuous kernel quality validation across multiple kernel versions and architectures

 Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for continuous kernel quality validation 
 Conduct performance benchmarking and regression detection across kernel releases 
 Measure and improve kernel code coverage, identifying gaps in test coverage and creating tests to address them 
 Execute and analyze stress tests covering CPU scheduling, memory management, I/O subsystems, networking, and filesystem workloads 
 Develop and maintain fuzzing harnesses to discover kernel vulnerabilities and reliability issues using tools such as syzkaller, Trinity, or custom fuzzers 
 Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team 
 Contribute to upstream test suites and testing frameworks 
 Document test methodologies, results, and coverage gaps 
 
 What we are looking for in you 
 
 Significant programming experience in Python 
 Experience with test frameworks such as LTP, kselftest, xfstests, stress-ng, fio, or similar 
 Experience designing and executing system-level tests: functional, stress, performance, or regression testing 
 Familiarity with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub CI, or similar) 
 Experience maintaining test suites over long periods, adapting to evolving software across multiple supported versions 
 Familiarity with Linux (Ubuntu or Debian preferred but not required), Linux kernel internals and subsystems 
 Experience with Linux systems administration and automation 
 Solid background with git

 Professional written and spoken English with excellent communication skills 
 Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

 Familiarity with kernel fuzzing tools and techniques (e.g. syzkaller, Trinity, AFL, or custom harnesses)
